user_story: As a staff member, I want deleting a confirmed booking to return an error so that active reservations are protected.

positive.title: Attempting to delete a confirmed booking returns an error
steps: Log in as a staff member
Attempt to delete the confirmed booking
positive.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that confirmed bookings cannot be deleted.

negative.title: Attempting to delete a non-existent booking results in an error
steps: Log in as a staff member
Attempt to delete a booking that does not exist
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the booking does not exist.

edge.title: Attempting to delete a confirmed booking with invalid credentials
steps: Log in with invalid staff credentials
Attempt to delete the confirmed booking
edge.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the user does not have the necessary permissions to delete bookings.
